extraction.text:
DAMANPREET KAUR

Senior Program Manager | AI & Digital Transformation

Phone: +91-92150820406

Email: dua.damanpreet@gmail.com

Location: Sirsa, Haryana, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Program Manager with approximately 15 years of experience leading large-scale digital transformation programs across Retirement, Wealth Management, Banking, Insurance, and Education domains.

Proven track record of driving AI-enabled operating models, automation-first platforms, and enterprise program delivery across global teams.

Expertise in Program Governance, AI Adoption Strategy, Product Roadmaps, Cross-functional Execution, and CXO Stakeholder Management.

Led initiatives integrating Generative AI, Agentic AI, Intelligent Automation, OCR, and AI Assistants to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and platform scalability.

Experienced in translating complex business problems into scalable technology programs, managing multi-vendor ecosystems, and delivering enterprise programs using Agile, SAFe, and data-driven decision frameworks.

CORE EXPERIENCE

~15 years leading enterprise-scale programs across Retirement, Wealth Management, Banking, Insurance, and Education.

Owned end-to-end program delivery including roadmap definition, execution governance, stakeholder alignment, and vendor management.

Led cross-functional teams comprising engineers, architects, data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders across global delivery environments.

Owned end-to-end transformation for a Retirement Line of Business by conducting BAU diagnostics, identifying automation opportunities, designing As-Is and To-Be process architectures, and delivering a transformation roadmap resulting in approximately 18 FTE operational cost savings.

Led a strategic vendor-driven transformation program with Genpact, delivering multiple initiatives that improved contact center efficiency, reduced Average Handling Time (AHT) by approximately 40%, and enabled scalable productivity improvements.

Drove AI innovation through Generative AI and Agentic AI Proof of Concepts (POCs), helping clients define future operating models and accelerate AI adoption.

Partnered with CXO leadership to define enterprise transformation roadmaps, automation strategies, and execution frameworks.

PROJECT EXPERIENCE

FIS – Retirement & Wealth Line of Business

Senior Program Manager

Feb 2025 – Present

Led a multi-stream digital transformation program across Retirement & Wealth platforms, delivering AI-enabled automation solutions to improve operational efficiency, compliance monitoring, and customer support capabilities.

Key Contributions

Owned delivery of AI-led initiatives including Cora Nudge Coach, Knowledge Assist, Agent Assist, and intelligent workflow automation.

Implemented OCR/ICR-based document extraction using Azure Document Intelligence to automate Money-Out transaction processing.

Introduced Agentic AI workflows to improve operational productivity.

Led cross-functional execution across engineering, product, and AI teams while ensuring strong governance and stakeholder alignment.

MetLife – Distribution Advantage Platform (DAP)

Senior Project Manager / Program Manager

Jul 2022 – Jan 2025

Led delivery of MetLife's global learning platform supporting training, certification, and sales enablement across 23 countries.

Key Contributions

Managed enterprise LMS program delivery supporting global learning and performance tracking.

Integrated AI-based learning recommendations and automated content delivery to improve user engagement.

Coordinated multi-country rollouts and stakeholder alignment across global distribution teams.

Enabled real-time training analytics and performance insights for executive leadership.

Fiserv – Signature Core Banking Solution (CBS)

Software Engineer (Developer & Lead)

Jan 2010 – Apr 2011

Worked on Fiserv Signature Core Banking Solution supporting feature enhancements and product maintenance.

Key Contributions

Contributed to core banking platform enhancements supporting banking operations and financial transactions.

Implemented product updates while ensuring platform stability across production deployments.

Collaborated with global teams for feature releases, defect resolution, and production support.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Consistently recognized by clients and senior leadership for delivery excellence and stakeholder management.

Honoured with the Tejaswani Award by Women Dedication Magazine for contributions as a motivational writer.

Published a peer-reviewed research paper on Agile Methodology Selection in IJREAM (UGC Approved, ASI Indexed, Impact Factor: 7.427).

Awarded Gold Medal by the Governor for securing first rank in B.Tech.

Received State-Level Scholarship and Honor Certificate from Guru Harkrishan Society, Chandigarh.

Winner of multiple Debate and Declamation competitions with media recognition.

STRENGTHS

Quick Learner

Proactive Leadership

Strategic Thinking

Stakeholder Management

Problem Solving

Team Building

Communication & Presentation

HOBBIES & INTERESTS

Writing blogs and motivational quotes

Painting and artwork (DkaurArt)

Publishing magazine articles

Community engagement through Inner Wheel Club (Editor)

Networking and mentoring
